coverage.note: Item model in src/domain/item.ts (id, title, url, tags, status default unread, ISO 8601 UTC timestamps); path resolution, ENOENT->empty load, atomic temp-file+rename save, and monotonic nextId (IDs never reused) in src/persistence/store.ts.
add(): unread item, missing-title and malformed-URL rejection, repeated tags, duplicate URLs allowed.
list(): newest-first sort, status/tag filters combined with AND.
start()/complete() set status and bump updatedAt from any prior status; unknown ID rejected.
remove(): deletes item, leaves nextId untouched so IDs are never reused; unknown ID rejected.
next(): oldest unread, optional tag filter, read-only (no status mutation), undefined when none match.
Argument parsing, command dispatch, actionable error messages, exit codes (0 success, 1 user error, 2 fatal).
Runtime target declared via engines.node >=18; no dedicated implementation file.
strict: true, NodeNext; typecheck passes with no type errors.
Zero runtime dependencies; only Node built-ins used. No dedicated implementation file.
Distinct domain/persistence/core/cli/bin modules, each independently testable.
Atomic save (temp file + rename) leaves the prior valid file intact on interruption.
Unit tests (domain/persistence/core) plus command-level integration tests against a temp file covering transitions, filtering, next, invalid input, missing IDs, atomic persistence.
npm scripts build/typecheck/test/lint (and format) all pass.
